messages:
mira: Starting region-by-region rollout for release v2.3.1-rc4. Plan is US canary -> EU gated -> APAC delayed start. Deploy bot will run canaries and emit metrics. Target change window 22:00-04:00 UTC. Need quick capacity + pin confirmation for EU + APAC. @leo @anya @samir :eyes:

deploy-bot: I have queued deploy id=deploy-3141 for v2.3.1-rc4. Canary slice -> US-1 starting now. Logs: https://deploys.redwood/dev/deploy-3141

leo: Quick capacity check — US headroom ~34 GPUs, EU headroom ~12 GPUs (10 reserved for bursts), APAC headroom ~6 GPUs (4 warm pool). Recommend APAC ramp limit to 15% traffic initially.

leo: sample commands i ran:
```
# region node counts
kubectl get nodes -l region=eu -o=custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,TYPE:.status.nodeInfo.operatingSystem
# padding calc
echo "reserved=10; total=22; cushion=$((total-reserved)); echo $cushion"
```

anya: Two quick notes: APAC has a local holiday window starting tomorrow for some teammates — ops coverage might be thin midnight-06:00 JST. Suggest delaying full APAC cutover by 48h or ensure fallback is automatic.

mira: Good call. New plan: EU canary after US baseline looks steady (~10m). APAC start will be gated + delayed: start APAC at T+6h after EU canary unless we explicitly override. Rollback triggers: p95 latency > 120ms OR error rate > 0.7% sustained for 5m -> immediate rollback. Anyone object?

samir: No objections. I'll pin EU routing to v2.3.1-rc4 and set automatic failover to v2.3.0 if rollback triggers. Command I will run in a moment:
```
router pin --region eu --version v2.3.1-rc4 --failover v2.3.0 --grace-period 30s
```

ops-bot: capacity-check finished: US=OK (34 GPUs free), EU=WARNING (10% cushion after reserved), APAC=WARNING (2 GPU cushion). See dashboard: https://infra.redwood/ops/capacity/314159 (refresh in 30s).

deploy-bot: US canary metrics (5m window): p95=95ms, errors=0.15%, token/s throughput nominal. No anomalous traces. Proceeding to gradual ramp for US only. Awaiting EU pin confirmation from @samir before EU canary.

mira: Thanks team. If EU canary green at 10m, we'll open EU to 10% traffic for 30m then decide on APAC schedule. Documenting decision and rollback rules in release notes before EU expand. :white_check_mark:
